values.task_boundary: Prepare, review, bind, and watch now; after the exact #5338 terminal gate implement only the portable adl-engine state machine and proof. Do not absorb compiler, records, Runtime, adapter, CLI, selector, parity, deletion, release, or deployment work.
deliverables: Independent adl-engine crate consuming the landed adl-compiler ExecutionPlan
Deterministic bounded scheduling and join state machine with stable transitions and limits
Typed provider/tool request-completion effects and stable idempotency contract
Bounded retry, cancellation, failure propagation, saturation, and resource-exhaustion semantics
Canonical quiescent checkpoint and strict resume-equivalence contract
Mapped #5338 plan/port fixtures plus golden, negative, permutation, saturation, and fresh-process resume proofs
Exact COTS, forbidden dependency, source LoC, test/fixture LoC, scope, and validation-latency evidence
Typed lifecycle, reviewed design/diagram, dependency watch, exact-revision review, publication, merge, post-merge, closeout, and retained receipt truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The engine consumes only the landed inert #5338 ExecutionPlan and produces typed state/effects/results without parser, compiler, Runtime, adapter, lifecycle, network, filesystem, database, process, thread, wall-clock, credential, cloud, or async-runtime authority

AC-2: Ready selection, dispatch, completion application, and final results are byte-deterministic across input collection order, completion arrival permutations, repeated runs, and fresh processes, with canonical node identity as the tie-break

AC-3: Joins, retries, cancellation, failure propagation, admission, saturation, attempts, bytes, events, checkpoints, and logical turns are explicitly bounded and prove limit-minus-one, limit, and limit-plus-one behavior without work loss or budget reset

AC-4: Provider and tool ports use distinct typed request/completion variants with stable request identity, attempt, idempotency, timeout, bounded payload, and fail-closed duplicate/unknown/mismatched completion behavior; production adapters remain outside WP-06

AC-5: Canonical checkpoints are emitted only when quiescent, reject every incompatible or truncated plan/state/limit/budget/sequence variant, and resumed execution is byte-equivalent to uninterrupted execution from the same boundary
AC-6: Every applicable landed #5338 plan, edge, and port fixture is mapped; engine cases pass and non-engine cases have explicit reviewed classifications with no silent skips or broad normalization

AC-7: Direct dependencies are exactly the landed adl-compiler crate plus reviewed serde, serde_json, sha2, and hex COTS; incumbent ADL, Runtime v2/v3, C-SDLC, async, HTTP, cloud, provider, database, graph, workflow, scheduler, retry, persistence, and RNG dependencies are absent

AC-8: WP-06 stays at or below 4000 Rust implementation LoC and 3500 test/fixture LoC; focused and quality validation each finish within 120 seconds, ordering/resume proof within 300 seconds, and the complete suite within 600 seconds under /Volumes/FastWork

AC-9: Product implementation starts only after #5338 is GitHub merged and a retained typed closed_out receipt with disposition merged and non-empty observed SHA exists, and that SHA is an ancestor of the #5340 implementation revision

AC-10: Exact-revision subagent review and fixes, typed review/publication, green required checks, authorized merge, post-merge validation, typed closeout, retained receipt, and guarded prune are all mandatory with no deferred acceptance row
